I downloaded this app for music and downloads, but it is currently missing basic functionality:
• AirPods Compatibility: It doesn’t work properly with AirPods/Bluetooth headphones.
• Background Play: The music stops immediately when I switch apps or lock my screen.
• Playback Controls: There is no way to skip to the next song or go back to the previous one from the lock screen or via headphone controls.

Dear developers of the File Management app, I kindly hope you can consider making the app more like it used to be. It was well-organized before, but now it has become very crowded and cluttered. Thank you very much. 🤍

reviews.title: Music does not play in background and does not appear in controls or CarPlay
reviews.text:
Music does not play in background and does not appear in controls or CarPlay

I am experiencing a serious issue with this app on iPhone. Music does not continue playing in the background at all. When I leave the app or lock my phone, the audio stops completely, and there is no media player shown on the lock screen or in the Control Center indicating that anything is playing.

In addition, when I connect my phone to my car (CarPlay or Bluetooth), the app does not appear in the car interface. This makes it impossible to easily control playback such as changing songs, pausing, or playing directly from the car system.

This significantly affects the user experience because any proper music app should support background playback and provide full media controls on both the lock screen and in-car systems
